headline: Hurricanes activate Jordan Staal from IR, will return vs. Kraken
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Carolina has activated Jordan Staal from injured reserve and he will return against Seattle, while Ryan Lindgren is also off IR for the Kraken, with Cale Fleury back in and Jagger Firkus set for his NHL debut. As NHL.com's Tom Gulitti posted, this will be Carolina's first game this season with its full lineup available, and the Hurricanes are 15-3-2.

Staal's numbers so far this season are quiet: no points in six games, and Carolina controls 45% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five-on-five, about 14 points worse than without him. That is a small sample, but it fits a team already sitting at 59.7% of expected goals overall. Seattle's record looks better than its play. The Kraken create 44.6% of expected goals, and their goals-minus-expected of +9.2 says finishing has covered for it. Lindgren and Fleury each sit near 47% at five-on-five, a small lift for a back end that needs the help.
